nm CFO QUALITY: H1 2026 CFO 1,866.6 includes +1,822.7 from deferred revenue (customer advances; deferred revenue 3,633.7 at 2026-06-30 vs 1,814.7 at 2025-12-31) and -1,048.0 inventories. Without the deferred-revenue inflow H1 CFO would have been ~44. Q2 2026 CFO (1,099.8) is therefore not a run rate of earnings conversion: advance payments reverse as projects ship. Treat FY2026 FCF as boosted by prepayments.

nm GAAP vs ADJUSTED: adjusted EPS excludes amortization of intangibles (Q2 2026 73.7 pre-tax), restructuring, contingent consideration (H1 2026 62.0 fair-value change) and M&A costs; FY2026 guidance: GAAP diluted EPS 5.82-5.92 vs adjusted 6.65-6.75 (release 2026-07-29). SBC is small (FY2025 45.9 = 0.45% of revenue) and is NOT added back in adjusted EPS, so GAAP EPS is after SBC.

nm ROIC CHECK: prefetch/forensic.json roic FY2025 0.304 uses invested capital = equity 3,941.3 + long-term debt 2,892.1 - cash 1,728.4 = 5,105.0 (matches the 10-K). Differences: short-term investments 99.5 (Treasury bills, held-to-maturity) are not subtracted (would raise ROIC slightly); restricted cash (61.4 at FY2025 in other current assets) is correctly not in cash; operating lease liabilities are not added as debt; goodwill 2,033.7 and intangibles from acquisitions are inside equity. NOPAT 1,400.0 uses GAAP operating profit after amortization. FY2024 ROIC (0.215) is not distorted by the warrant liability loss (449.2), which sits below operating profit. At 2026-06-30 cash is 2,810.6 plus 300.0 short-term investments against long-term debt 2,939.8: net debt about -170.8 (net cash) before the UIG and King Environmental acquisitions that closed 2026-10-26/27 (cash effect not yet filed: gap).
